title: Cost and distribution of seeded verification
statement: Let $n,r$ be natural numbers, let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over the field with two elements, and let a seed map each length-$r$ Boolean bit vector to a vector in the field’s $n$-dimensional cube. For any Boolean target, the seeded verification program has the distribution obtained by drawing a length-$r$ Boolean vector uniformly and returning the corresponding seeded matrix-product verification result with cost $(0,0,r+6n^2+4n+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: three n by n matrices over the field with two elements
